findingDetails.title: The skill README still states 46 command rows while the fixed catalog states 47
findingDetails.case: A maintainer reads README.md for the number of command rows the bridge deriver covers, sees 46, and concludes one TypeScript-served row has no embeddingText; command-bridges.generated.json reports 47 TypeScript-active rows and the fixed leaf says 47.
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n "command rows the TypeScript scorer serves" over .skilled returns this README line and the fixed catalog line; the other 46/45 occurrences are a feature count and a historical release note.

findingDetails.title: The router still says the hook scope names five hook docs after the fix added a sixth
findingDetails.case: A maintainer enumerates the hook leaves to check that DSH documentation is routable, counts six entries in leaf-scopes.json and five in the router sentence, and cannot tell whether the sixth is intentional.
findingDetails.scopeProof: jq over leaf-manifest.json prints six hooks/ leaves; rg -n "five hook" outside changelog returns only ROUTER.md:103.
